summary: Official Maharashtra land-record map services and an official Bhusawal taluka village map were found, but no anonymous Bhusawal parcel ID-plus-polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Marathi discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-9017-bhusawal.json. First-party sources establish Maharashtra land-record custody and Bhusawal village-map context, not open citywide parcel geometry coverage.

The official MRSAC Bhusawal taluka PDF was identified as contextual administrative/village-map evidence. No login, credentials, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS disablement was used.
